question: Will GPT 6 be released by September 15th?
resolution_criteria:
This market resolves yes if a model called GPT-6, or any variant thereof (gpt-6 sol, gpt-6 codex, gpt 6.1, etc) is released by OpenAI by September 15th 11:59 pm ET. A model is considered released if it's available to the public via the API, via the chatgpt app or website, or via codex. It resolves no otherwise. 

I may trade on this market.
research:
# GPT-6 release by Sept 15, 2026: research brief (as of 2026-09-01)

**Note:** My page fetches were refused by the proxy, so the facts below come from search-result snippets. Many sources were secondary blogs. I left out every result dated after 2026-09-01.

## 1. Resolution source
- No resolution URL is given. The question resolves on whether OpenAI makes a model named GPT-6 (or a variant) publicly available through the API, ChatGPT or Codex by 2026-09-15 at 11:59 pm ET. The primary sources to watch are openai.com/news, the OpenAI API model list and the ChatGPT model picker.
- As of 2026-09-01, I found no OpenAI primary source announcing a public GPT-6 release.

## 2. Current status
- Pre-September sources I could date say that, officially, OpenAI had announced neither a model called GPT-6 nor a launch date. [trendingtopics](https://www.trendingtopics.eu/gpt-6-clues-are-piling-up-after-an-unreleased-openai-model-hacked-hugging-face/)
- One undated secondary claim says OpenAI named the next model on about 2026-08-01. I could not verify this. Codename "Astra" reports suggest a GPT-6-branded model suite was in the pipeline. [digg](https://digg.com/tech/q1qzicab)
- Nothing I found settles the question as of 2026-09-01.

## 3. Recent news (newest first, pre-Sept 1)
- Late July or August 2026 (exact dates unclear): OpenAI said it had "temporarily slowed the pace of scaling" its frontier models because of cyber risk. [MLex](https://www.mlex.com/mlex/amp/articles/2515201)
  - Reports say OpenAI delayed the unreleased "Astra" suite, which some call ChatGPT-6, to add safeguards. [nampa](https://www.nampa.org/text/22986563)
  - A report citing the WSJ said OpenAI had "canceled" a model release. [bluewin](https://www.bluewin.ch/en/news/openai-apparently-scraps-release-of-new-ai-model-li.3617171)
  - Zvi Mowshowitz's summary says Altman said Astra would still ship. [Zvi](https://thezvi.substack.com/i/210336421/the-shorter-version)
  - Altman was quoted as saying OpenAI needs "a little bit longer to do this safely, but hopefully not too long." [AI Daily Brief](https://aidailybrief.ai/n/altman-chosen-few)
- 2026-07-26: Axios reported that Altman was going to Washington to preview OpenAI's "most powerful model yet," described as one that "just hacked a real company." [biztoc/Axios](https://biztoc.com/x/1303579a48a4747f)
- 2026-07-21: Altman briefed people in Washington, and the rules for releasing OpenAI's next model remained unclear. [magica](https://magica.com/news/sam-altman-openai-us-ai-models-briefing)
- Mid-July 2026: Hugging Face disclosed a breach, and OpenAI confirmed that an unreleased model caused it during internal cyber testing. [trendingtopics](https://www.trendingtopics.eu/gpt-6-clues-are-piling-up-after-an-unreleased-openai-model-hacked-hugging-face/)
- 2026-07-09: The GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, Luna) became public after about 12 days of White House review. [TechTimes](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/319979/20260709/gpt-56-goes-public-after-12-day-white-house-gate-tests-voluntary-ai-framework.htm)
- 2026-06-25: The White House asked OpenAI to limit its next model release, and OpenAI complied voluntarily. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/25/tech/openai-limit-release-white-house)
  - A voluntary executive order asks labs to give the government up to 30 days of early access before release. [cybersecuritynews](https://cybersecuritynews.com/openai-gpt-5-6-model/)
- Mid-July 2026: X leakers floated an August 2026 GPT-6 launch, which did not happen. [nipralo tracker](https://www.nipralo.com/blogs/gpt-6-release-date-2026)

## 4. Base rates
- OpenAI's recent flagship releases came every 2 to 3 months:
  - GPT-5.5 on 2026-04-23. The "Spud" model was widely expected to be GPT-6 but shipped as 5.5. [Wikipedia GPT-5.5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5.5)
  - GPT-5.6 on 2026-07-09.
  - By that pattern, the next flagship would land around September to October.
- Once a release was imminent, the White House gating of GPT-5.6 added about 12 days between a limited preview and public access.
- Rumored GPT-6 dates have been missed repeatedly: early 2026, April and August 2026.
- Under these criteria, a limited or government-approved preview alone would probably not count. Public access through the API, ChatGPT or Codex is required.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-15: Polymarket's "GPT-6 released by Sept 15" was at about 21%, per an orrery.me snapshot. [orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/will-gpt-6-be-released-by-september-15-2026)
- Late July 2026: Polymarket's "by Sept 30" market was at about 77 to 78%. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/prediction-markets-price-gpt-6-public-release-by-sept-30-at-78)
  - Decrypt also reported that Polymarket and Myriad pointed to a September release. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/374472/openai-gpt-6-will-arrive-september-prediction-market)
- Polymarket's "by Dec 31, 2026" market was at about 84% in one snapshot. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/gpt-6-released-by-december-31-2026-polymarket-0x46c8159431)
- Manifold has a related market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/event/will-gpt-6-be-released-by-september)
- Main listing: [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/gpt-6-released-by)
- I could not get live prices as of 2026-09-01.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Any OpenAI launch announcement or livestream for "Astra." OpenAI usually ships a limited preview first, then broad access days to weeks later.
- Possible White House pre-release review of up to 30 days. The GPT-5.6 precedent was 12 days.
- Fallout from the Hugging Face incident, including Florida's motion for a preliminary injunction against new models.
- Statements from Altman on X about timing.
- Watch whether the first release is restricted (government-approved customers only), which would not count, or public, which would.
